coverage_note: Arabic script only until ~05:00; everything after is Latin transliteration by the engine. Long stretches 20:00-31:00 and 39:00-40:30 have Medi's Arabic words dropped entirely (blank slots after 'uh,'), so several fixes there (flight/meetings/parents, 'what you told me') are reconstructed from her English prompts and chat lines. Speaker labels look right. English-only stretch 47:20-48:57 (Farsi chat) and 54:38-55:35 (app talk). Not written per S4: kuffet->khuffet (09:13), sawa vowel length (46:13), double-T commands ma tedta'eb hom / matabina (53:44, 58:42), hasab for 3assab throughout, azra2 (04:27). Time fact confusion at 03:41-04:13 (tlat/tnteen, 26) treated as content not language. Latin grammar-B count kept low because the engine's spelling can hide/add prefixes. medi_turns = Medi turns carrying Arabic (script or transliterated), estimated by script (~51 script + ~100 Latin).
